full_details: It was St Valentine's day. You were not in the Knave. You went to the Rose at two. The flag was up. You stood by a post on the left and looked at the yard more than at the stage. A tall boy in a buff jerkin and breeches, with a staff, cudgelled three Spanish swaggerers, and the yard roared for a woman who beats men. Alleyn was easy in a part smaller than himself. Henslowe stood at the door and counted heads with his lips, and he did not tell you the count. Outside, Alleyn said a brief cordial word. At home the notes were ungenerous on one half and useful on the other. The worst sentence was about Alleyn's ease. You were ashamed of it because he had been kind, and you left it. You did not send Sunday's letter. The moon was full.
one_sentence: You paid a penny to stand in the Rose yard for Long Meg, and at home you kept the bad sentence on the page.
title: A penny at the Rose
